title: Exported fnv1a does not compute the documented 32-bit FNV-1a hash
evidence: Independently reproduced in the root audit worktree. BigInt XOR/multiply/modulo-2^32 arithmetic gives 4f9f2cab; the exported function returns a82fb4a1. Its floating-point multiplication loses low bits.
status: Confirmed. Expected-failure regression is in the group3 worktree pending review and merge; application code remains unchanged.

title: VS Code reinforcement omits the required signal and supplies a file path as a memory ID
expected: The selected memory receives useful reinforcement and its persisted modified date becomes today.
actual: The real CLI rejects the command because --signal is required; the memory remains dated 2000-01-01.
evidence: The public extension command was invoked through a VS Code host boundary double and executed the local CLI. A temporary probe supplying --signal useful and the fixture memory ID makes the expected-failure test unexpectedly pass.
status: Confirmed. Retained as it.fails; passing restoration and inverse repair probes recorded. Application code unchanged.

title: VS Code memory-directory validation accepts names such as .gnosys-other
expected: The outside-memory-directory warning appears and reinforcement is not invoked.
actual: Substring validation accepts .gnosys-other and invokes the reinforcement subprocess.
evidence: The selected path ends in .gnosys-other/memory.md. Requiring an exact path component makes the expected-failure test unexpectedly pass.
status: Confirmed. Retained as it.fails; passing restoration and inverse repair probes recorded. Application code unchanged.

title: VS Code reinforcement evaluates shell syntax in selected filenames
expected: The literal argument decisions/$(touch audit-injected).md reaches the CLI without evaluating the shell expression.
actual: The argument becomes decisions/.md and a harmless audit-injected marker is created in the isolated fixture directory.
evidence: The real shell ran only a harmless touch command inside the temporary test project. Replacing shell interpolation with execFileSync argument passing makes the expected-failure test unexpectedly pass.
status: Confirmed. Retained as it.fails; passing restoration and inverse repair probes recorded. Application code unchanged.

title: VS Code dashboard action invokes a removed CLI command
expected: The terminal runs a supported CLI command and exits successfully.
actual: npx gnosys dashboard exits 1 because dashboard is not a registered command.
evidence: The terminal host double executes the real built CLI through a local npx shim. A temporary supported status --system command makes the expected-failure test unexpectedly pass.
status: Confirmed. Retained as it.fails; passing restoration and inverse repair probes recorded. Application code unchanged.
